notes: The black bar at the top of videos is fixed at the source. iOS was painting that strip itself: it colors the status-bar area from the app's theme color instead of letting the video run underneath it, no matter how the page is laid out — that's why it survived every layout fix. Reelio no longer declares a theme color anywhere (page or app manifest), so the video now extends all the way under the time and battery. This version also refreshes the launch setup iOS saved when the app was first added to your home screen, the first time it opens after you tap Update. If the bar is somehow still there after that first reopen, delete the Reelio icon from your home screen and add it again from the site — iOS keeps a copy of the old frame with the icon, and re-adding is the only way to make it let go.
